name: runweave.list_nodes
description: List authorized nodes and scheduling availability; bounded page.

name: runweave.list_resources
description: List logical resources and authorized locations/revision evidence, never physical roots.

name: runweave.execute
description: Submit one explicit operation and quickly return its execution view. Reuse request_id after uncertain replies. process.exec may require local approval. args are literal/path objects.

relative_path.description: Resource-relative slash path; root is '.', no absolute path, dot segments, backslash, colon or controls. At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
Resource-relative slash path; root is '.', no absolute path, dot segments, backslash, colon or controls. At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

literal.description: One literal argv item, unchanged; no shell or URI substitution. No NUL; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

relative_path.description: Resource-relative slash path; root is '.', no absolute path, dot segments, backslash, colon or controls. At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

name: runweave.get_execution
description: Query by exactly one execution_id or caller-scoped request_id. Poll according to poll_after_ms; UNKNOWN must not be retried under a new key.

name: runweave.cancel_execution
description: Persist cancellation intent. cancel_requested is not proof of stopped work; query until a confirmed outcome.

name: runweave.read_artifact
description: Read a bounded, currently authorized artifact chunk by opaque ID. Returns base64, never accepts a file path.
